title: KU2D YouTube Metadata, Transcript, Comments & Acquisition Pattern v2
objective: In one continuous queue, extend the existing YouTube acquisition design from metadata-only foundations into a durable YouTube content-and-audience acquisition architecture covering metadata, Thai/English transcript or captions only, comments/replies, cross-content semantics, KU2D-to-KU2A dataset contracts, deterministic fixtures/tests, and YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2. Perform Branch Handoff Protocol v1 first, then continue without returning control between phases unless repository integrity or coordination protocol requires fail-closed stop.

work_phases.name: Existing YouTube foundation and expanded metadata capability
requirements: Inspect all merged YouTube acquisition policies, schemas, fixtures, tests, results, and source-registry records before editing.

Map existing supported metadata and gaps across channel, playlist, video enumeration, video details, category, duration, language/default-language signals, live/broadcast status where available, statistics, publish/update timestamps, thumbnails, tags/topics where contractually available, and relationship identifiers.
Keep observed API fields, derived fields, unavailable fields, and proposal-only fields explicitly distinct.
Document endpoint/quota implications and any owner-authorized-only metadata capability separately from public-read capability.
Do not infer unavailable semantics from display order, counters, or missing fields.

work_phases.name: Transcript and captions capability with strict language scope
requirements: Design transcript/caption acquisition for Thai and English only. Do not retain or normalize transcript text in any other language.
Represent language scope canonically as allowed_languages=[th,en]. Other-language tracks may be observed only as availability metadata if needed, never acquired/retained as transcript content.

Separate manual captions, auto-generated captions, translated tracks, original-language tracks, owner-authorized caption download, and any public transcript surface. Do not conflate capability classes.
Define deterministic selection precedence when both Thai and English tracks exist and when multiple tracks of the same language exist; preserve original vs translated vs auto-generated provenance.

Define normalized transcript_segment entity with video identity, segment order, start/end or duration when available, text, language, caption kind, source surface/API, acquisition timestamp, provenance, and completeness indicators.

Model cases: manual Thai, manual English, auto-generated Thai, auto-generated English, both languages, unsupported-language-only, no captions, captions disabled/unavailable, private/deleted/unavailable video, partial transcript, timestamp gaps, translated track, and owner-authorization-required track.
No-transcript and unsupported-language-only must not automatically be classified as extraction failure.

work_phases.name: Comments and replies capability
requirements: Design commentThreads/comments acquisition including top-level comments, replies, pagination, publishedAt, updatedAt, likeCount where available, author/channel identifiers exposed by the API, moderation/deletion states where observable, and comments-disabled behavior.
Separate requested ordering from representativeness; displayed/API order must never be interpreted as population sentiment or demand.
Define normalized comment and comment_reply entities, stable relationship keys, source provenance, acquisition timestamp, original publish/update timestamp, and completeness/coverage indicators.
Define quota and bounded pagination semantics and stop conditions.
Model disabled comments, no comments, replies absent, replies partially returned, deleted/unavailable content, pagination, duplicate observation, edited comments, and quota/budget boundary cases.

work_phases.name: Cross-content semantics and quality boundaries
requirements: Encode explicit rules: transcript != description; creator speech != viewer opinion; comment count != sentiment; ordering != representativeness; moderated/deleted comments imply potentially incomplete sampling; transcript absence != irrelevance; metadata statistics are observation snapshots, not causal explanations.
Define provenance and authority separately from interpretation.

Define Deep Audit gates per module and module-level status values such as required, optional, unavailable, owner_authorized_only, public_accessible, evidence_withheld, unsupported_language_only, and comments_disabled where appropriate.
Define source-level exit 0/2/1 without treating optional-module absence as a technical failure unless the contract requires that module.

work_phases.name: YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2
requirements: Produce a durable v2 pattern: Channel Discovery -> Playlist/Video Enumeration -> Metadata -> Thai/English Transcript/Caption -> Comments/Replies -> Normalize -> Provenance -> Quality/Deep Audit -> Dataset Intake.
Make module requirements configurable and fail-closed; metadata may be required while transcript/comments can be optional depending on acquisition objective.
Separate official API methods, owner-authorized methods, public transcript surfaces, and non-durable/non-approved methods.
Do not add browser scraping, challenge bypass, auth bypass, or undocumented endpoint dependence as an approved durable pattern.

work_phases.name: KU2D to KU2A Dataset Intake contracts
requirements: Define storage-neutral entities and relationships for channel, playlist where useful, video, transcript_segment, comment, and comment_reply.
Include acquisition timestamp, original publish/update timestamps, language, transcript/caption kind, relationship keys, provenance, completeness indicators, module status, and quality/audit fields.
Design so KU2A can perform text analytics, sentiment, topic analysis, semantic search, and temporal analysis without knowing YouTube-specific acquisition logic.
Do not implement analytics or ML in this queue.

work_phases.name: Offline fixtures, validators, deterministic tests, and readiness
requirements: Add offline fixtures covering metadata, Thai/English transcript cases, comments/replies, pagination, disabled/unavailable content, language filtering, quota boundaries, provenance, Deep Audit, and partial acquisition.
Add fail-closed validators and deterministic tests without weakening existing YouTube, supermarket, retail, marketplace, coffee, governance, or handoff regressions.

Produce a final YouTube v2 readiness report that states metadata readiness, Thai transcript readiness, English transcript readiness, comments readiness, owner-authorization dependencies, quota implications, public-read capability, remaining gaps, and the smallest bounded live pilot required to validate unresolved behavior.
Recommend an appropriate pilot source such as Q-Diving only if supported by repository evidence; do not execute that pilot in this queue.

external_research_policy.note: Documentation research may be used to map capabilities, but no live YouTube content/source acquisition is authorized by this prompt. Any unresolved behavior requiring a live API call must be carried forward as a separately governed bounded pilot objective.

quality_rules: Code/contract capability must not be confused with live proof.
Absence, disabled state, unsupported language, access restriction, quota boundary, and extraction failure are separate classifications.
Do not promote candidate evidence, Reviewed Corpus, Core Knowledge, Human Confirmation, or Ground Truth automatically.
Do not mutate parked references or production/scheduler state.
Do not silently broaden from Thai/English transcript scope to other languages.
deliverables: Expanded YouTube metadata capability map and contract
Offline fixtures, fail-closed validators, deterministic regression tests, and CI coverage
YouTube v2 readiness report with bounded future live-pilot recommendation

completion_behavior.if_phase_blocked: record blocker and continue remaining offline phases where safe
